items.title: 67256_Paul L. Howard oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee (Paul L. Howard) does not speak in the provided context. The mention of Dick Poppa is made by the Interviewer, who states 'I know they called him Dick Poppa'. There is no evidence in the text that Paul L. Howard had a personal relationship with Dick Poppa.

ctx.x: clubs when we ran out of tape.

Yes, the Apex, and the Club Alabam. I produced the shows and Pappy's and what was the name of the place in Gardena. I know they called him Dick Poppa or something, but I can't think of the name, and the RumBoogie that was here on Highland. I did shows there.
